lead.title: So What’s Going On With the Cybercab?
lead.summary: Tesla began offering Cybercab rides in Austin on 4 September 2026, charging a median $3.33 USD per mile. The vehicle includes a NACS port and wireless charging receiver, but lacks an onboard charger to accept AC power from a home supply.

leads.title: Spain's transport minister steps down 6 days after fatal high-speed rail crash
leads.summary: Spain’s Transport Minister Óscar Puente announced Tuesday that he is stepping down six days after a high-speed train collision south of Madrid killed 69 people. Puente cited the severity of two major accidents on the Madrid-Seville line in less than a year as the reason for his resignation.

leads.title: DJI Dock 4 Lands in Tatra Mountains: Autonomous Rescue, No Handler Required
leads.summary: Poland's TOPR deployed DJI Dock 4 in the Tatra Mountains, enabling autonomous drone rescue missions without a human handler. The system uses a 25-second battery swap and mountaintop relay nodes to support Beyond Visual Line of Sight operations across the range.

Mountain rescuers turn to automated DJI drones to save time

A Ukrainian company has unveiled the ultra-lightweight ground robot "Krit"
stories.summary: Ukrainian company Vitrolom unveiled the Krit, a 4.6 kg tracked ground robot designed to deliver explosives to enemy positions. The base version costs 25,000 hryvnias, carries up to 16 kg of payload, and can be transported by heavy bomber drones. Following field tests, the company began selling the system to units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces.

stories.title: Epiroc expands autonomous SmartROC fleet
stories.summary: Epiroc expanded its autonomous SmartROC D65 MKII fleet to customer sites including Fortescue’s Solomon and Eliwana operations in Australia, Luck Stone’s Rockville site in the US, and KGHM’s Robinson Mine. The drills automate the full cycle with minimal human intervention, integrating with the LinkOA platform to manage plans and monitor activity in real time.

stories.title: SkyDrive Partners with Goyang and Verty to Advance eVTOL Deployment in South Korea
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with Goyang Special City and Verty Co. Ltd. to establish operational infrastructure and conduct flight trials for commercial eVTOL flights in Goyang City. The partnership aligns with South Korea’s roadmap to launch commercial eVTOL operations by 2028.

stories.title: U.S. clears Jordan to buy 1,500 APKWS drone-killing rockets
ROBONEERS’ BULLDOG Drone Completes First Combat Trials with the 23rd Brigade
stories.summary: Ukrainian manufacturer ROBONEERS deployed its BULLDOG multi-purpose UAV with the 23rd Mechanized Brigade for four combat sorties. The drone conducted strike missions at ranges up to 15 km, carrying payloads weighing up to 9 kg.

stories.title: Lithuania considers state-owned drone holding company to boost domestic industry
stories.summary: Lithuania's Defence Minister Robertas Kaunas proposed establishing a state-owned drone holding company to direct funding toward specific military drone sectors, including FPV, interceptors, and reconnaissance. Kaunas said he plans to present the idea to industry representatives in the near future, though he did not provide a timeline for the company's formation.

stories.title: Japanese Finance Minister Observes SkyDrive eVTOL Flight Test
Munich Aeroacoustics Finds That Fractal Vertipad Surfaces Could Reduce eVTOL Noise
ERA Executive Director to speak at inaugural Railway Gazette Summit
stories.summary: France’s Métropole Européenne de Lille will donate 23 surplus trams to the Ukrainian city of Mykolaiv to help maintain public transport services during the war.

stories.title: Bullet train, less than 300 days to go: What's built and what isn't
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw says India is likely to get its first bullet train on 15 August 2027, covering the 50 km Surat to Bilimora section of the 508 km corridor. NHSRCL figures show 371 km of viaduct and 98 km of track linked, with the project cost likely to reach ₹1.98 lakh crore.

stories.title: Counter-UAS RF Detection Systems Market Gains a USD 2,710.18 Million Horizon by 2035 as Passive Airspace Secur
stories.summary: SNS Insider projects the Counter-UAS RF Detection Systems market will grow from USD 482.36 million in 2025 to USD 2,710.18 million by 2035, registering a CAGR of 18.84% during 2026-2035. North America led with approximately 38.62% of global revenue in 2025, while Asia Pacific is projected to record the fastest regional growth at approximately 22.46% CAGR.

stories.title: KDF Opens Talks With Jordan on Specialised Drone Warfare Training
stories.summary: The Kenya Defence Forces and the Jordanian Armed Forces explored specialised training in counterterrorism, drone operations and counter-drone capabilities during a meeting in Aqaba, Jordan. No agreement or timeline for the proposed engagements was announced.

stories.title: More drone detection systems proposed for airports in Vietnam
stories.summary: Vietnam’s Ministry of Construction proposed the Ministry of Public Security invest in additional equipment to detect and neutralize illegal drones, citing that existing equipment remains insufficient to meet operational demands.

stories.title: SkyGrid Outlines Automation and Common Operating Picture Approach to Integrating Advanced Air Mobility Into Existing Airspace
stories.summary: SkyGrid outlined an approach to integrate Advanced Air Mobility into existing national airspace by automating routine tasks like flight plan validation and strategic deconfliction. The company proposes adding these tools to legacy systems to manage high-density uncrewed aircraft and eVTOLs in low-altitude airspace, while keeping controllers at the center of air traffic management.

stories.title: Taiwan firm signs MOU with Ukrainian drone company on supply chains
stories.summary: Taiwan's AerosoarX signed a memorandum of understanding with Ukrainian drone company UFORCE on Wednesday to explore supply chain cooperation. The agreement aims to use Taiwan's manufacturing capabilities to help UFORCE diversify component suppliers and build a more resilient supply chain.

stories.title: Massive Russian drone attack: Ukraine's air defenses intercept 272 targets overnight
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 310 attack drones at Ukraine overnight on November 4, with Ukrainian air defenses neutralizing 272 targets by 8:00 a.m. The drones originated from areas in Russia and occupied Crimea, striking 19 locations and leaving debris at 15 others, while more than 20 drones remained in airspace as combat operations continued.

stories.title: Smart City Expo showcases an autonomous air taxi
stories.summary: EHang said its pilotless electric aircraft was operating in 40 zones in China when it appeared at Smart City Expo. The two-seat eVTOL has a range of 30 kilometres, or 15 to 20 minutes depending on its load.

also.title: Smart City Expo displays air taxi, traffic robots and solar street lamps

stories.title: DN Solutions showcases AI-powered manufacturing techs at RobotWorld 2026
stories.summary: South Korea’s DN Solutions announced on Nov. 4 that it is participating in RobotWorld 2026, showcasing advanced manufacturing technologies that integrate machine tools, robotics, and AI. The company is demonstrating an automated manufacturing cell combining its second-generation DVF 5000 five-axis vertical machining center with a collaborative robot, and its iDOO RMS+ solution received the Vanguard Award at the event.

stories.title: Agreement between Novamarine and Edge Europe on autonomous naval drones
stories.summary: Novamarine and Edge Europe signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly develop autonomous naval drones. Novamarine will manufacture the platforms at its Olbia plant, while Edge Europe supplies the autonomous navigation systems.

stories.title: Varjo and Finnish Defence Forces Collaborate on Virtual Counter-UAS Training
stories.summary: Varjo announced a collaboration with the Finnish Defence Forces Innovation Unit to pilot virtual counter-UAS training using XR-4 Series mixed reality headsets. The partnership, which began preparations in February 2026, aims to improve soldiers' readiness against drone threats without consuming real resources.

stories.title: Stark Unveils Vanta 24: An Autonomous Warship for the Baltic Sea
stories.summary: German defense contractor Stark unveiled the Vanta 24, a 24-meter autonomous warship designed to enhance NATO naval capabilities in the Baltic Sea. The vessel features modular armament, including anti-ship missiles and the Cascade loitering munition, and operates using Stark’s Minerva software for autonomous navigation and collision avoidance.

stories.title: Russian drone hits energy facility in Ternopil Oblast
JOBY Stock In Focus: ARK Invest Analysts See Autonomous eVTOLs Matching Taxi Fares Ahead Of Joby Aviation Earnings
stories.summary: ARK Invest analyst Tasha Keeney predicts autonomous electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft will eventually offer fares competitive with traditional taxis. Joby Aviation will report third-quarter earnings on Nov. 4, with analysts expecting $40.42 million in revenue and a loss of $0.25 per share.

stories.title: Daedong leads 300 billion won robot farm hub plan in South Korea’s Saemangeum
stories.summary: Park Tae-joon, a Hanyang University professor, announced a 300 billion won plan to build a 21-hectare agricultural physical AI industrial hub in the Saemangeum area of Gimje. The project aims to secure more than 1 million agricultural work experience data points and achieve a robot labor participation rate of 70% or higher from 2028 to 2032.

stories.title: Russia Arms Ka-52M, Mi-8AMTSh-V and Ka-29 helicopters With New Anti-Drone Weapons
Kyiv Startup Builds 10-Ounce Radio Receiver to Intercept Russian Molniya Drone Feeds
stories.summary: CODE380, a Kyiv startup, built the D·Vision SDR, a 10-ounce receiver that converts unencrypted Russian drone camera feeds into live video. The device scans 500 MHz to 8.7 GHz, covering a band Molniya drones adopted in June, and displays analog video from up to 6 miles away.

stories.title: ​Ghost Shark Gets Teeth – Australia Reveals How Its Extra-Large Autonomous Submarine Can Deploy Swarm of Drones e.g. Right Off China’s Coast
stories.summary: The Australian Department of Defence and Anduril Australia showcased the Ghost Shark, an extra-large autonomous underwater vehicle capable of carrying up to 24 Altius 600-series UAVs, 12 smart sea mines, and cargo containers. Serial production is scheduled to begin in late 2025, with Australia having ordered dozens of these vehicles for 1.12 billion US dollars.

stories.title: Urban rail industry news round-up
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India's 23.3 km Pune Metro Line 3 on November 3, with passenger services starting the following day. In Australia, the Victorian Infrastructure Delivery Authority announced the preferred bidder to rebuild Sunshine station and committed to starting Stage 2 works in 2028.

stories.title: United Airlines doubts Boom Supersonic's targeted schedule
stories.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby stated on October 28, 2026, that Boom Supersonic will likely miss its 2029 entry-into-service target due to complex development and regulatory certification processes. United signed a June 2021 agreement for 15 Overture aircraft, contingent on meeting performance and safety criteria, while Boom Supersonic completed assembly of its first Sprint Core prototype engine on October 22, 2026.

stories.title: Developing the robotics industry: Vietnam prioritizes industry, logistics, and agriculture.
stories.summary: Le Minh Nhat, a PhD student in Computer Science at George Mason University, advised Vietnam to prioritize industrial production, logistics, and agriculture for robotic applications. He suggested leveraging strengths in information technology, artificial intelligence, and system integration to build domestic technological capabilities while using imported components in the short term.

stories.title: Florida DOT Stages eVTOL 'Flying Car' Demonstration Flight Between Tampa and St. Petersburg
stories.summary: The Florida Department of Transportation held a piloted electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) demonstration flight between Tampa and St. Petersburg on Friday. The flight was part of the Federal Aviation Administration's eVTOL and Advanced Air Mobility Integration Pilot Program.

stories.title: Volkswagen and Stellantis advance self-driving car plans in China and France
stories.summary: Volkswagen Group China secured a Level 3 autonomous driving road test permit in Hefei, China, authorizing real-world testing and large-scale data collection. Stellantis announced partnerships with Wayve, Nvidia, and the French government to advance autonomous vehicle deployment in France, and with Bolt and the Métropole du Grand Paris to introduce autonomous mobility services by experimentation across Greater Paris starting in 2028.

stories.title: Why Spain Is Losing Control Of Its High-speed Rail Network
stories.summary: A state-operated Renfe train collided with a stationary Iryo service near Urda, killing 69 people, including two Australians. Investigators cite a control center error that cleared the Renfe train to move despite an active safety halt.

stories.title: THE KOREA INDUSTRY DAILY: ROBOTWORLD 2026 to Spotlight Physical AI and AI-Driven Manufacturing With 402 Exhibitors From 17 Countries
stories.summary: ROBOTWORLD 2026 will gather 402 companies from 17 countries at the Korea International Exhibition Center (KINTEX) in Goyang, South Korea, from Nov. 4–7. The 1,198-booth exhibition will feature Physical AI and AI-driven manufacturing systems, with international participants including Taiwan's Advantech, Japan's FANUC, and China's Booster Robotics, PAXINI, and Unitree.

stories.title: General Atomics, AFRL Eye Next Steps for Autonomous Drone Concepts
stories.summary: General Atomics is developing a hybrid-electric flying wing drone called NextGen, capable of flying more than 60 hours, while the Air Force Research Laboratory recently flew the XQ-67A prototype under the Demon APE program to test autonomous mission systems.

stories.title: Saildrone Beats the Navy in Court Over a $2.1 Billion Drone Boat Snub
stories.summary: A federal judge ordered the US Navy to reevaluate Saildrone’s proposal in its $2.1 billion Medium Unmanned Surface Vessel competition, finding the service acted arbitrarily. The Navy may now obligate no more than $1.5 billion for construction, leaving about $600 million unspent until the evaluation concludes.

stories.title: Drone Defense And Deterrence Questions In Germany
stories.summary: In early August, a small drone armed with Semtex failed to arm and explode after striking a Ukrainian Antonov aircraft parked on an isolated apron at the Leipzig airport. A second drone collided with a cargo aircraft, forcing an emergency landing.

stories.title: Railway expands parcel services for Singles' Day rush
stories.summary: China Railway Express launched a 20-day express delivery operation on Sunday to handle the Singles' Day rush, with high-speed rail capacity expected to increase 10 percent year-on-year. The service runs through Nov 20, utilizing about 1,900 high-speed passenger trains daily to carry parcels in express storage cabinets and available space.

stories.title: Drone Attack on Ozon Warehouse
stories.summary: Russian e-commerce giant Ozon reported that a drone struck its warehouse in Adygeysk, southern Russia, triggering a fire and forcing employees to evacuate. The company temporarily suspended deliveries from sellers and redirected incoming shipments to other warehouses, while Kyiv accused Ozon’s distribution network of facilitating the movement of military equipment.

also.title: Drone strikes Ozon logistics center in southern Russia, triggering fire
Drones hit Russian e-commerce giant Ozon's fulfillment hub in Adygeysk

stories.title: NASA X-59 Quiet Supersonic Aircraft Flies Six Times in One Week and Reaches Mach 1.53
stories.summary: NASA's X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft completed a record six flights in a single week, flying twice on Sept. 22 and twice each on Sept. 24 and 25. The run beat the aircraft's previous single-week record by two flights and brought its total to 38 test flights.

stories.title: France to Spend €63.4 Billion on Defense in 2027 as Euronaval Speech Highlights Naval Drones
stories.summary: French Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin announced at the Euronaval trade show that the 2027 draft budget will increase defense spending to €63.4 billion, a €6.5 billion rise over 2026. The budget, submitted to the National Assembly and Senate in October, awaits a vote expected this month, with rejection resulting in a freeze rather than a cut.

stories.title: Russian builder tests unmanned cargo boat for Ob and Irtysh River supply runs
stories.summary: Russia's Pskov Boat Shipyard tested an unmanned cargo boat on Lake Pskov, with a representative of the Russian Maritime Register of Shipping attending as an expert observer. The vessel, which has a maximum cargo capacity of 1,500 kg, will soon begin delivering construction materials, food, and fuel to remote settlements on the Irtysh and Ob Rivers with no people aboard.

stories.title: Tesla crash LA — Autonomous Vehicle Hits Fire Hydrant in South El Monte
stories.summary: A Tesla operating in autonomous mode struck a fire hydrant at the intersection of Santa Anita Avenue and Central Avenue in South El Monte around 4:17 AM on the 3rd, leaving two occupants uninjured. San Gabriel Valley Water Company crews cut off the water supply after firefighters struggled to stop the flow, while authorities restricted access to the area during cleanup.

stories.title: Tesla misled South Korean customers about automated-driving tech, consumer group alleges
stories.summary: A consumer group alleges Tesla misled South Korean customers by selling Full Self-Driving (FSD) software for 9.043 million won ($6,726) to vehicles that cannot legally use it. The software is compatible with only about 20% of Tesla cars registered in the country, mainly US-made models.

stories.title: Europe Plans Naval Drone Attacks on Russian Tankers
stories.summary: European countries plan naval drone attacks on Russia's shadow fleet in the Baltic and North seas, with operations overseen by Stephen Bryan. German firm Stark Defence began mass production of Vanta 24 unmanned vessels, which cost roughly 1,000 times less than a traditional frigate and can carry payloads up to 50 tonnes.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics unveils second-generation Stretch logistics robot with improved durability
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled the second-generation Stretch logistics robot on Tuesday, reducing internal wiring by 81 percent and upgrading joints to improve durability based on 100,000 hours of operational data. The company plans to expand supply to DHL and other global logistics firms, with DHL having signed a memorandum of understanding to introduce more than 1,000 additional units.

also.title: Boston Dynamics cuts Stretch robot cabling by 81%, speeds up repairs in Gen 2 upgrade

stories.title: Bulgaria Joins NATO Drone Defense Project After Drones Sink Two Ships
stories.summary: Bulgaria signed on October 30 to join NATO’s Air Defence Capabilities Against Lower-Level Air Threats High Visibility Project, a multinational program for buying and developing defenses against drones and cruise missiles that fly low. Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov signed the accession note, and the National Assembly still has to ratify it.

stories.title: China's EHang establishes regional hub in Thailand to support eVTOL ecosystem development
stories.summary: EHang announced the establishment of an overseas regional hub in Thailand to support international electric vertical take-off and landing (“eVTOL”) aircraft deployment, regional resource coordination and project implementation across Southeast Asia and other emerging markets. In the near term, EHang plans to deploy an initial fleet of 25 units of EH216-S pilotless passenger-carrying eVTOL aircraft in Thailand.

stories.title: Humanoid Robots in Warehouses vs AMRs: Which Automation Makes Sense in 2026?
stories.summary: GXO and Agility Robotics announced a commercial Robots-as-a-Service agreement in June 2024 to deploy Digit in warehouse operations. The robot handles repetitive material-moving tasks, including transferring totes to conveyors, while working alongside existing automation such as autonomous mobile robots.

stories.title: Wildwood Crest Police Use Drone to Find Missing Dog [VIDEO]
stories.summary: The Wildwood Crest Police Department used its Drone Unit to locate a missing dog in the dunes near Sunrise Park on Monday. Officers detected a heat signature using the unmanned aircraft system's thermal imaging capabilities after the dog ran off while being walked on a leash.

stories.title: Californians revolt against police drones after rapid adoption across state
stories.summary: California police departments are expanding drone programs to conduct everyday patrols and active investigations, a shift that has triggered public backlash and legal challenges. The San Francisco Police Department recently sought approval for broader drone use, while Sonoma County settled a lawsuit by the ACLU of Northern California after investigators found hundreds of warrantless searches.

stories.title: Kodiak AI Delivers Western Star 49X Trucks to Atlas Energy Solutions, Beginning Next Autonomous Chapter in the Permian Basin
stories.summary: Kodiak AI delivered the first two Western Star 49X trucks equipped with the Kodiak Driver to Atlas Energy Solutions in September. These are the first of 65 trucks to fulfill Atlas’s initial order of 100 Kodiak-equipped driverless trucks, with Kodiak on track to complete that order in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Modular Gun Systems Might Make Drone Strikes Optional
stories.summary: BAE Systems and Aselsan are marketing modular deck gun systems for merchant ships at the Euronaval show, offering alternatives to accepting drone and missile strikes. Aselsan's Gokdeniz system features a twin 35mm turret firing up to 1,100 rounds per minute, while BAE Systems proposes a 40mm Bofors gun with programmable ammunition and optional integrated fire control radar.

stories.title: KNAPP Establishes Robotics and AI Innovation Hub in Boston, Plans 35 Jobs
stories.summary: KNAPP established KNAPPRobotics.ai Inc. in Somerville, Massachusetts, to create a U.S. robotics and artificial intelligence development hub. The facility is expected to employ 30 to 35 people by early 2027, focusing on software development, AI, and computer vision to accelerate commercialization of warehouse automation technologies.

stories.title: Ben Waters on the latest wireless charging strategies
stories.summary: Ben Waters, CEO of WiBotic, discussed wireless charging strategies for mobile robot fleets on The Robot Report Podcast. He explained how opportunity charging reduces downtime for fleets of 20 to 40 robots and advised companies to plan power infrastructure, battery size, and maintenance during system design.

stories.title: Pentagon is beginning to follow Ukraine into wider use of ground robots
EU and Bpifrance Target 30 French-Ukrainian Drone and Defense Deals
stories.summary: The European Commission and Bpifrance launched a €150 million guarantee programme on November 3 to facilitate 30 French-Ukrainian defense partnerships over three years. The initiative targets sectors including drones and communications, with Ukrainian companies able to borrow up to 85% of commercial contract values.

stories.title: Ukraine Will Fund Drone-Fired Air-to-Air Missiles to Catch Jet Shaheds
stories.summary: Ukraine's Brave1 cluster opened grant competition No. 11 on October 29, offering up to four grants of as much as ₴75 million each to build drone-launched air-to-air missiles. The Ministry of Defence aims to cut the cost of intercepting jet-powered drones like the Geran-4, with winners required to reach the required readiness level within 16 months.

stories.title: Houston Weighs Counter-Drone Bid as Texas Pot Shrinks to $10.5M
stories.summary: Houston City Council votes Wednesday on whether the Mayor’s Office of Public Safety and Homeland Security can apply for FEMA’s Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Grant Program. Texas will receive $10,508,140 for the whole state in this round, and FEMA expects to pick projects on December 2 and issue awards on December 10.

stories.title: A French Sovereign Drone, Ordered From a Chinese Catalogue
stories.summary: Airbus displayed the U050 Capa-X at Euronaval in Paris, claiming it is a sovereign design for the French Navy and Army. The article alleges the airframe matches the Mugin UAV GV500 and GV600 platforms, contradicting Airbus's claims of uncompromising airworthiness and national sovereignty.

stories.title: Safran and UVAD Technologies join forces to power Falcon supersonic UAV
stories.summary: Safran Power Units and UVAD Technologies Inc. announced a partnership to power the Falcon Supersonic UAV with two turbojet engines. The system enables supersonic speeds at low and medium altitudes for missile defense training, with ground testing scheduled for 2026 and flight tests in 2027.

stories.title: Driverless Tesla Robotaxis are now cruising in Fort Worth
stories.summary: Tesla launched driverless Robotaxi service in Fort Worth on Monday, November 2, covering a roughly 145-square-mile area that includes Benbrook, Forest Hill, Haltom City, River Oaks, Saginaw, and White Settlement. The service uses modified Model Y electric vehicles seating up to four passengers, making Fort Worth the seventh U.S. market in the network.

also.title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) Rises 1.0% on Fort Worth Robotaxi Launch (Nov 2)

stories.title: TAA Compliance Shapes Battery Strategy in America’s Drone Market
stories.summary: Enovix and Rincell are positioning their battery products for U.S. federal drone procurement by meeting Trade Agreements Act compliance requirements. Enovix manufactures TAA-compliant batteries in South Korea, while Rincell plans to launch fully domestic cell production in Fremont, California, in late 2027.

stories.title: Beta boss Clark believes A250 will beat eVTOL rivals to certification
stories.summary: Lufthansa Group carrier is the first European operator to sign an agreement with the US-based eVTOL developer. Operator highlights importance of real-world trials ahead of first electric aircraft deployment from 2028.

stories.title: Good Work Pays Off on the Red River Valley & Western Railroad
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration selected the Red River Valley & Western Railroad for a CRISI grant of up to $23,646,750 to replace approximately 26.4 miles of rail and 19,200 ties between Gwinner and Wyndmere, ND. The project will also extend the existing 1,800-foot siding at Wahpeton Junction to approximately 10,000 feet.

stories.title: KUKA to Feature Advanced Industrial Robot and Mobile Automation at the Smart Technology Expo 2026
stories.summary: KUKA Robotics will exhibit a KR AGILUS industrial robot, an LBR iisy collaborative robot, and a KMP 250P autonomous mobile robot at Smart Technology Expo 2026 in Guadalajara, Mexico, from November 18-20. The company will demonstrate pick-and-place applications and 3D vision-guided picking in booth C20, while Christopher Hernández participates in a panel discussion on November 18.

stories.title: Ethiopian Rebels Deploy Drones
stories.summary: A series of explosions at Ethiopia’s defense headquarters and military bases in late September raise concerns that northern rebels might be using drones to extend their fight to other parts of the country. Witnesses told the Ethiopian Observer that a small, short-range drone exploded inside the Ethiopian Air Force base at Bishoftu, about 40 kilometers southeast of the capital, Addis Ababa.

stories.title: UCLA stockpiles huge arsenal of drones, ammo for emergencies
stories.summary: The UCLA Police Department spent more than $220,000 on drones and less-than-lethal munitions in 2025 and is seeking approval to purchase more. The department bought three Skydio X10s and 120 40 mm munitions, and it is requesting 1,950 additional PepperBall rounds and 50 more 40 mm projectiles to support campus expansion and the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

stories.title: AIRO Group offers upside as military drone demand accelerates: Roth Capital
stories.summary: Roth Capital Partners initiated coverage of AIRO Group Holdings with a Buy rating and $16 price target, citing growing demand for military drones and a potential revenue surge in 2027. The firm projects AIRO's revenue to increase from approximately $134 million in 2026 to $207 million in 2027, driven by drone deliveries and expansion into autonomous aircraft.

stories.title: Video: A fire has been burning for a second day at the "Samara" gas station in Russia following a drone attack
stories.summary: A drone strike on November 2, 2026, ignited a fire at the “Samara” Linear Production and Dispatch Station in the Samara Region, which has burned for a second day despite local authorities claiming the attack was repelled. The Kazakh Ministry of Energy temporarily suspended crude oil transit to Russia via the Atyrau-Samara pipeline due to infrastructure damage at the facility, which stores over 1.6 million cubic meters of crude oil.

also.title: Kazakhstan suspends oil supplies to Russia amid drone attacks

stories.title: Airbus ends Wingman drone to meet Germany’s accelerated operations timeline
stories.summary: Airbus ended development of its Wingman drone to meet Germany's accelerated timeline, shifting focus to the U760 Ravenstorm Collaborative Combat Aircraft. The U760 targets a 2032 service entry, while the U740 Valkyrie aims for a 2029 requirement.

stories.title: Waymo Pushes Into LA’s South Bay as Robotaxi Map Widens Across 15 US Cities
stories.summary: Waymo extended its Los Angeles robotaxi service to Torrance, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach on Tuesday, expanding the service area to 210 square miles. The Alphabet unit is scaling operations in five cities, adding nearly 250 square miles of territory across Los Angeles, Nashville, Orlando, San Diego, and the San Francisco Bay Area.

stories.title: Mountain rescuers turn to automated DJI drones to save time
stories.summary: Poland's TOPR is piloting DJI Dock 4 technology to launch Matrice 5TD drones from automated rooftop docks, reducing the up to two hours it currently takes to reach remote Tatra Mountain accident sites. The system uses DJI O4 ground stations to extend coverage and swaps batteries in 25 seconds to maintain continuous aerial search operations.

also.title: Automated Drone Technology Further Transforms Polish Mountain Rescue Operations
DJI Dock 4 Lands in Tatra Mountains: Autonomous Rescue, No Handler Required

stories.title: Prototype X-BAT VTOL ‘Fighter’ Drone Unveiled
stories.summary: Shield AI shared the first look at a full-scale prototype of its X-BAT jet-powered stealth ‘fighter’ drone, which is designed to both take off and land vertically from a tail-sitting position. The drone is in the process of being moved from the company’s main hub in Frisco, Texas, to its flight test facility in Newton, Kansas.

also.title: First look: Shield AI rolls out X-BAT 001 as autonomous fighter approaches flight testing
First full-scale X-BAT combat drone prototype packs 2,000-mile range, vertical flight

stories.title: Drones built to look like birds evaded detection at Air Force tech exercise
stories.summary: Ornadyne’s O1 ornithopter drone evaded sensor detection at the Air Force’s September “Game of Drones” exercise at Edwards Air Force Base. The 1-pound drone, which flaps wings instead of using propellers, registered as a bird to counter-UAS systems deployed by other private companies.

stories.title: USDOT deploys $1.24B for rail work via IIJA funds
OpenRoboto and Vulcan Shield Hungary Launch Commercial Robotics Data Pilot
stories.summary: OpenRoboto launched its first commercial robotics data pilot with Vulcan Shield Hungary at a production workstation in Békéscsaba to capture human operating expertise for task-specific robot capabilities. The three-stage collaboration begins with simulation and data capture using OR-S1 egocentric headsets, with model training and on-site robotic testing planned for subsequent stages.

stories.title: Westborough braces for round-2 on Amazon drone delivery
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its drone proposal in Westborough, leaving the Zoning Board of Appeals with nothing to rule on as the board keeps the appeal open to revisit in early December. Company spokesperson Lindsay Hamilton said Amazon will resubmit a “revised project soon, after further discussions with local stakeholders.”

stories.title: Securing autonomous fleet communications at scale with mTLS over QUIC using Network Load Balancer passthrough
stories.summary: AWS published a technical guide demonstrating how to secure autonomous fleet communications using mutual TLS over QUIC with Network Load Balancer passthrough. The article details a reference implementation for Zipline, which operates drone fleets, showing how to configure Amazon EKS and the AWS Load Balancer Controller to maintain connection stability during cellular handoffs.

stories.title: Defense contractors to demo cargo drones for US Marine Corps
BAE Systems launches new Sea Tridon naval gun series
stories.summary: BAE Systems debuted the Sea Tridon naval gun series at the Euronaval defense show in Paris, offering three variants derived from the Bofors 40 Mk4. The company is discussing integration of the guns on unmanned systems with several navies, though it has not yet secured a launch customer.

stories.title: Norway strengthens border surveillance system to detect drones near Russia
stories.summary: The Norwegian Armed Forces are deploying NASAMS sensors in Kirkenes to detect drones near the Russian border. The unit, comprising more than 30 military personnel, will be stationed within the Ranger Battalion GSV in Sør-Varanger by the end of the year.

stories.title: MTDG Launches Industrywide Survey to Shape a Trusted Drone Component Marketplace
FMD debuts AutoHook at Euronaval 2026 for autonomous USV recovery
stories.summary: Fairbanks Morse Defense debuted AutoHook, a fully autonomous vessel recovery interface developed by Vestdavit, at Euronaval 2026 in Paris. The system enables launch and recovery of uncrewed surface vessels without human intervention and achieved operational acceptance at Sea State 4, surpassing standard solutions restricted to Sea State 2.

stories.title: Tesla forced to rename 'misleading' Full Self-Driving technology in the UK and Europe — as BMW readies its own automated driving rival for 2027
stories.summary: Following intervention from Germany’s transport ministry, Tesla agreed to rename its Full Self-Driving technology to “Tesla Assisted Driving” in Europe and the UK. The change addresses concerns that the previous name was misleading, as the system requires drivers to remain attentive at all times.

also.title: Tesla renames Full Self-Driving as Tesla Assisted Driving in Europe and the UK
Tesla owners can earn up to 12 months of free Full Self-Driving (FSD) via the Referral Program
80 Tesla Owners Arrested For Allegedly 'Jailbreaking' Full Self-Driving Mode

stories.title: Naval Group Unveils SCX26 Drone Mothership Concept With 96 Missile Cells
stories.summary: Naval Group unveiled the SCX26 drone mothership concept at Euronaval 2026 on November 3, featuring 96 vertical launch cells and an internal drone mission bay. The proposed warship, targeting the 2040s, combines conventional naval firepower with onboard additive manufacturing to sustain dispersed drone forces during intensive combat.

also.title: Naval Group unveils drone ship at Euronaval
Two Superstructures, Railgun, and Drones: Naval Group Unveils the SCX 26

stories.title: Schneider shifts eastern intermodal freight to Norfolk Southern
stories.summary: Schneider named Norfolk Southern its primary eastern rail provider Oct. 29, with the agreement taking effect Jan. 1. The company said the deal expands its reach, supports new freight, and enables potential transcontinental service with Union Pacific.

stories.title: Russia gives its drones bigger antennas to beat Ukraine's jamming
stories.summary: Russia is upgrading its attack drones with larger anti-jamming antennas to counter Ukraine's electronic warfare systems. The upgrades use Kometa satellite-navigation modules with 16-element antenna arrays, with 20-element versions prepared for serial production.

stories.title: Numo Robotics Unveiled the Loko ROV for Cargo Transport and Equipment Recovery
stories.summary: Numo Robotics developed Loko, a wheeled ground robot designed for logistics and the evacuation of damaged military equipment. The system can carry loads weighing up to 500 kg and can also help retrieve other ground drones from the battlefield.

stories.title: A Renaissance Of U.S.-Based Drone Battery Production
stories.summary: Global Ordnance plans to deliver 10,000 batteries in 2027, scaling to 150,000 by 2029, while Amprius received a grant worth up to $75 million to add 12 million silicon anode cells annually by early 2028.

stories.title: Cheyenne Finance Committee to talk Reed Avenue Rail Corridor project expansion
stories.summary: The Cheyenne Finance Committee is set to discuss a plan to increase the Reed Avenue Rail Corridor Design Project contract by $1,166,647, bringing the total cost to $2,487,566. If approved, the expansion would add street improvements to Snyder and Bent Avenues, a parking lot, and pedestrian connectivity, extending the completion date to April 30, 2028.

stories.title: Nuro Trains Police as Uber, Lucid Gravity Robotaxi Nears Launch
stories.summary: Nuro met with police departments in Mountain View, Palo Alto, and Los Altos to prepare for its robotaxi launch with Uber and Lucid, the company said on Tuesday. The partners are targeting a San Francisco Bay Area launch this year, though the program still lacks the state permits needed for driverless or paid rides.

stories.title: Can Commercial Drones Survive Electronic Warfare? U.S. Army Expands Testing Opportunities
Lockheed Martin to build five Vectis combat drones with flight demonstrations due in 2027
stories.summary: Lockheed Martin will use its own funds to build five Vectis autonomous combat aircraft, with flight demonstrations scheduled for 2027, Chief Executive Jim Taiclet said. The company anticipates an opportunity under the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft Increment 2 program and is designing the aircraft for air-to-air combat and strike missions.

stories.title: US Navy Procures Autonomous Minesweepers Under $53.9 Million Deal
stories.summary: The US Navy signed a $53.9 million contract with Thales subsidiary Advanced Acoustic Concepts to acquire two unmanned minesweepers for the Strait of Hormuz. The vessels use towed sonar and Automatic Target Recognition software to detect and classify underwater mines, with neutralization capabilities planned for a later phase.

stories.title: Satellite Connectivity for Drones Moves Closer to Commercial Scale
stories.summary: Galaxy 1 Communications and Viasat announced an agreement on November 2, 2026, to move their jointly developed Velaris satellite communications platform into commercial production. The partnership provides systems for customer onboarding, billing, and network management to support autonomous aircraft and advanced air mobility operations.

stories.title: ETH Zurich Develops Flexible Drone That Can Survive Collisions
stories.summary: Researchers at ETH Zurich developed FlexiQuad, a flexible drone that withstands collisions at speeds of approximately 25 kilometers per hour while reaching 80 kilometers per hour during normal flight. The design uses a ring-shaped frame that bends sideways to absorb impact, allowing the drone to remain airborne and continue missions in tight spaces.

stories.title: Elbit Systems Expands Integrated Naval Protection Suite To Counter Unmanned And Underwater Threats
stories.summary: Elbit Systems is participating in Euronaval 2026 in Paris, France, where it is showcasing maritime defense solutions. The company offers an integrated naval protection suite combining electronic warfare, Counter-UxS technologies, kinetic defense, and underwater sensing capabilities.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Test Fleet Expands to Detroit
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its Cybercab testing to Metro Detroit, deploying approximately two dozen autonomous vehicles from a Southfield, Michigan facility. The test cars, equipped with temporary steering wheels and human drivers, operate on roads including Interstate 696 and M-10, while Tesla has not provided a timeline for public operations.

also.title: Tesla Tests About Two Dozen Cybercabs on Detroit Roads

stories.title: Latvia believes one of two drones that violated its airspace was Russian, the other Ukrainian
stories.summary: Latvia’s military said on Tuesday it believed one of two drones that violated the country’s airspace in recent days was of Russian origin, while the other was of Ukrainian origin. The armed forces warned on Sunday and again on Monday of threats in Latvia’s airspace near the borders of Belarus and Russia, asking people in the area to seek shelter, and in the latter case said NATO had activated air policing fighter jets.

stories.title: UK Deploys Protector Drone to Track Russian Frigate in English Channel
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force Protector RG1 conducted its first operational sorties in UK airspace, providing over 10 hours of surveillance as HMS Dauntless and HMS Tyne shadowed the Russian frigate Neustrashimy in the English Channel between October 1 and October 14.

stories.title: As drones multiply, the battle to control low-altitude airspace intensifies
stories.summary: Airwayz integrated its OVERWATCH command-and-control platform with more than 45 sensors, effectors, and command-and-control systems during a recent NATO exercise. The platform achieved SAPIENT compliance, an interoperability standard designed to facilitate communication between different sensors and systems.

stories.title: Washington blocked Polestar. So why are Chinese-built robotaxis on American streets?
LLANGENNECH: Train firm blames a signaller for the diesel fire and wants £30m from Network Rail
stories.summary: DB Cargo UK is suing Network Rail for more than £30m, arguing a signaller failed to stop the 2020 Llangennech fuel train derailment. Network Rail counters with a claim for over £5m against DB Cargo and wagon owner Touax Rail, who denies liability. No hearing date has been set.

stories.title: MassDOT breaks ground on rail improvements to support permanent Berkshire Flyer service
stories.summary: MassDOT broke ground on rail infrastructure improvements in Pittsfield, Mass., to support permanent seasonal Berkshire Flyer service. The project includes a passing track in Richmond and upgrades at CSX's Pittsfield Yard, with $31 million allocated in the fiscal year 2027–2031 Capital Investment Plan.

stories.title: CTDOT starts construction on new train station in Enfield
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation (CTDOT) has started construction on a new train station in Enfield, Conn., and restore passenger rail service to the town for the first time since 1986. The $125.3 million project is anticipated to be completed in fall 2030 and will fill an approximately 15-mile gap between Springfield Union Station and Windsor Locks.

stories.title: US Army flies first 3D-printed heavy-fuel engine to extend tactical drone range
stories.summary: The US Army successfully flight-tested its first 3D-printed heavy-fuel hybrid engine installed in the VICTOR unmanned aircraft. The air-cooled design eliminates liquid coolant, extending mid-sized tactical drone reach to support future autonomous swarm missions under the PULSAR initiative.

also.title: Army Flies 3D-Printed Kerosene Engine on VICTOR Drone to Eliminate Gasoline Supply
US Army Tests Drone Powered by a 3D-Printed Engine

stories.title: Russia Threatened Terra Drone. Its CEO's Biggest Worry Is Taiwan
stories.summary: Terra Drone president Toru Tokushige warned that a Taiwan crisis would halt drone production because the company relies on foreign suppliers for most components. He stated that rebuilding those parts domestically would take six months to a year, leaving Japan vulnerable to attack during that window.

stories.title: Specialist drone-detection equipment brought to Jersey as investigation continues
stories.summary: The government confirmed that specialist drone-detection equipment is now in Jersey to help agencies detect and respond to further drone activity at the Airport. Police are continuing to pursue all credible lines of enquiry into suspected drone sightings on Friday and Saturday evenings that caused significant disruption, including three inbound aircraft diversions and nine cancelled clinical procedures.

also.title: Illegal Drone Incursions Cancel Jersey Airport Flights And Trigger RAF Deployment
Jersey Strengthens Drone Detection Measures Following Airport Disruption

stories.title: French defense minister kicks off ‘pact’ with industry in rush to field naval drones
stories.summary: French Minister of the Armed Forces Catherine Vautrin announced a new government-industry “pact” on Nov. 3 to accelerate the development of naval drones. The initiative includes purchasing a second ROV Deep Sea drone from LD Travocean and eight A18 countermine robots from Exail.

also.title: France launches industry pact to develop naval drones — Defense News

stories.title: US Army advances first vehicle-mounted laser weapon production to destroy enemy drones
stories.summary: Leonardo DRS will supply power management, thermal control, and integration expertise for AeroVironment's LOCUST X3 laser weapon production under the Army's E-HEL program. The 30-kilowatt LOCUST X3 is designed to counter Group 1–3 drones and integrate with platforms such as the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle.

also.title: Leonardo DRS Fixes Power and Heat Flaws for Army’s First Production Drone Laser
AV selects Leonardo DRS for US Army laser C-UAS programme

stories.title: Russia’s “Terminator” Tank Support Vehicle Spotted With Basic Anti-Drone Nets Instead of Armor
stories.summary: Russian forces deployed BMPT tank support vehicles fitted with flexible mesh barriers at the front and rear during spring 2026 exercises. The makeshift protection leaves upper surfaces exposed to aerial attacks, and the rear-mounted mesh visibly swings as the vehicle moves.

stories.title: Why Is the Pentagon Lending $450 Million to a Drone Developer?
stories.summary: The Department of Defense’s Office of Strategic Capital announced a conditional loan commitment of up to $450 million to Neros to expand domestic production of small unmanned aircraft systems and components in Torrance, California. The financing supports vertical integration to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and meet growing military demand for inexpensive drones.

also.title: U.S. Backs $450M Financing Plan to Expand Neros Combat Drone Production and Cut Reliance on Foreign Components.
Neros plans $615M drone manufacturing expansion in US
China Makes 100 Drones For Every One Built In US As Pentagon Scrambles To Catch Up
Pentagon Signs $450M Neros Loan to Mass-Produce Domestic Drone Components

stories.title: HII and Thales Demonstrate Expeditionary PathMaster’s Ability to Deliver an End-to-End Autonomous MCM
stories.summary: HII and Thales demonstrated an end-to-end autonomous mine countermeasure capability using Thales’ Expeditionary PathMaster architecture. The system integrated HII’s REMUS 620 unmanned underwater vehicle, Thales’ SAMDIS 600 sonar, and ANGLER neutralization capabilities into a unified workflow for mine detection, classification, and neutralization.

stories.title: 36Kr Exclusive: Shanghai Jiao Tong University PhD Graduate Integrates World Models with Six-Arm Robots, Secures Hundreds of Millions Yuan New Financing and Partners with Multiple Fortune 500 Clients
stories.summary: Shanghai SAZHI Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. completed a Pre-Series B financing of hundreds of millions of yuan from China Construction Investment Co., Ltd., Nantong Investment Management, and Yunqi Partners. The company will use the funds for large model R&D, multi-arm robot prototype iteration, production line expansion, and global market development.

stories.title: Alpha Unmanned Systems Closes €4 Million Financing Round
stories.summary: Alpha Unmanned Systems closed a €4 million financing round on November 3, 2026, backed by Cesce, Banco Santander, Bankinter, and BBVA. The Madrid-based company will use the funds to build a new production plant, hire staff, and accelerate expansion into Europe, the United States, Latin America, and Asia.

stories.title: New ISO interoperability standard covers collaboration among mobile robots from multiple vendors
stories.summary: The Association for Advancing Automation published ISO 21423:2026, an international standard for communications among industrial mobile robots from different vendors. The standard specifies how robots, fleet managers, and other equipment exchange information to improve system efficiency and reduce path interference.

stories.title: Purdue’s Windracers ULTRA First Flyer in Indiana Drone Corridor
stories.summary: Purdue University's Windracers ULTRA completed the first beyond visual line of sight flight in the new Indiana Drone Corridor, covering more than 50 miles during an opening event at Terre Haute Regional Airport. The university will use the aircraft to test emergency supply drops for flood-affected communities.

also.title: Windracers ULTRA flies BVLOS in Indiana’s new drone corridor
Purdue-Owned Windracers ULTRA Is First Autonomous Aircraft to Fly BVLOS in Indiana Drone Corridor

stories.title: Autonomous Freight Rail Pilot to Begin in 2027
stories.summary: Intramotev plans to deploy two battery-electric TugVolt railcars on the 21-mile Columbia Terminal Railroad in early to mid-2027, following a $16.2 million Federal Railroad Administration award. The three-year demonstration will progress through milestone-gated stages toward autonomous mainline operations, beginning with local service to seven customers in the Columbia area.

stories.title: Spanish Army's Own Experts Say Red Tape Is Slowing Its FPV Drone Shift
stories.summary: Ten Spanish Army specialists told a University of Granada researcher that legal and bureaucratic procedures are slowing the military's adoption of FPV drones. The Spanish Army established its FPV flight school, the Escuela Práctica de Vuelo, in October 2025, but rules allowing the Army to certify pilots flying drones under 25 kg (55 pounds) were still being developed.

stories.title: Germany Wants to Watch Russia’s Shadow Fleet. Its New Drone Ship Could Help Track It
stories.summary: German defense startup Stark Defence plans to launch the Vanta 24, a 24-meter unmanned surface vessel, in 2027 to monitor Russia’s shadow fleet and protect underwater infrastructure. The Berlin-based company stated the vessel can carry 50 metric tons of payload and reach speeds exceeding 40 miles per hour, offering a cheaper and faster deployment alternative to crewed warships.

also.title: Dronemaker Stark Designs Uncrewed Ship to Hunt Russia’s Shadow Fleet
German company “Stark” is developing an unmanned ship that will track Russian shadow fleet vessels

stories.title: Anti-drone nets have already been installed along more than 1,640 km of Ukrainian roads
stories.summary: The State Special Transport Service installed more than 1,640 kilometers of anti-drone defenses along key logistics routes since the beginning of 2026. In Kharkiv, the first anti-drone corridor covers a 6.5-kilometer section of the Kharkiv Highway with seven-meter-high nets.

stories.title: From Airborne to Action: Powering the Public Safety Response
stories.summary: Versaterm DroneSense connects drone operations with computer-aided dispatch (CAD), allowing dispatchers to request drones within their existing workflow. The platform shares live video with authorized users and automates the collection of flight information, including location, duration, and operational use.

stories.title: Türkiye’s MKE Debuts PIRANA Armed USV Variant with Drone Payload
stories.summary: MKE unveiled its PIRANA Armed USV variant at Euronaval, featuring a 1,000-kilogram payload bay capable of carrying eight tube-launched unmanned aerial vehicles. The vessel, which offers a 400-nautical-mile range and speeds exceeding 35 knots, serves as a command and control node for drone swarms.

stories.title: FCC Still Weighing Thermal and Spray Drone Ban, Adam Chan Says
stories.summary: Federal Communications Commission senior national security counsel Adam Chan said the agency is still considering a ban on imports and sales of previously approved foreign drones in categories designated military-grade, including thermal, LiDAR, spray, swarming, and docking drones, as well as anything weighing 55 pounds or more. The FCC is reviewing comments and could allow a transition period if it imposes a ban, according to Chan, who leads its national security work and reports directly to Chairman Brendan Carr.

stories.title: Bologna receives first modern trams
stories.summary: CAF delivered the first three of 33 trams for Bologna’s new network under a €130m contract signed in October 2024. The vehicles are undergoing test runs on a two-stop section of the Red Line between Borgo Panigale depot and Via Cavalieri Ducati.

stories.title: Adnoc expands AI across energy operations, with 70 robotic use cases
stories.summary: ADNOC is expanding artificial intelligence and robotics across its energy operations, with more than 200 AI applications and 70 robotics use cases deployed or under development. The company announced a multi-year agreement with OpenAI and G42 to connect AI-driven decision-making across production, processing, logistics, sales, and trading.

stories.title: Video: Figure’s new humanoid robot workforce takes first steps outside US factory
stories.summary: Figure shared video footage of newly manufactured Figure 03 humanoid robots walking out of its BotQ factory. The California-based company has produced more than 1,000 units, increasing its manufacturing rate from one robot per day to one per hour.

stories.title: Drone attacks increase pressure on Russia’s aviation sector
stories.summary: Flight restrictions at Russian airports increased due to Ukrainian drone attacks, causing flight delays and cancellations that disrupted air travel.

also.title: Russia Imposes Over 3,500 Airport Flight Restrictions in 2026 Amid Ukrainian Drone Attacks

stories.title: One Soldier, 200 Drones: Palladyne Says It Can Do It Tomorrow
FAA Streamlines Airspace Requests for Some Tower Inspections
Fayetteville Readies 911 Drone Fleet as Council Member Questions Axon Deal's Power
stories.summary: Fayetteville police expect drones to start answering 911 calls within the first three months of 2027, launching from five stations around the city as part of a technology overhaul that has already stirred debate on the city council. The drones will not patrol neighborhoods or conduct general surveillance, according to the department — they will be dispatched only to specific calls for service, flying ahead of officers to give them a view of a scene before they arrive.

stories.title: China Physical AI Roundup: GenRobot AI, RoboScience Secure Funding, Plus Anyverse, Orbbec Expand Deals
stories.summary: GenRobot AI raised $100 million in a Series A+ round, with strategic backers including SAIC Motor, Baidu, and Shoucheng Holdings. The Beijing company develops gear and software that turn recordings of human work into training data for robots.

stories.title: Rheinmetall Unveils Kraken K3 Naval Drone and MASS Nova Decoys at Euronaval
stories.summary: Rheinmetall is showing its Kraken K3 unmanned surface vessel and MASS Nova decoy launcher at Euronaval in Paris from November 3-6, 2026. The Kraken K3 has entered series production at Blohm+Voss facilities in Hamburg, with initial capacity set at around 200 units a year.

stories.title: AGIBOT Unveils Worken Productivity Framework and New Robot Platforms at Innovation Day 2026, Pushing Humanoid Robots Toward Commercial Scale
stories.summary: AGIBOT unveiled its Worken productivity framework and new robot platforms at Innovation Day 2026 on October 29 at the Shanghai World Expo Center. The company introduced the GO-3 Preview embodied foundation model, which topped RoboDojo, RoboTwin, and RoboColiseum benchmarks, alongside the G2 Max wheeled robot with a 50kg dual-arm payload capacity.

also.title: Humanoid Robot Makers Track Output but Not Payback

stories.title: Autumn Weather Cuts Ukraine's Drone Interception Success Rate
stories.summary: Autumn fog and rain have reduced Ukraine's drone interception rates to 65–70%, forcing greater reliance on fighter jets amid a shortage of Patriot missiles. Aviation expert Bohdan Dolintse stated that interceptor drones typically shoot down around 90–95% of targets under normal conditions, but recent interceptions in poor weather have achieved success rates of only 65–70%.

stories.title: XTEND AI Robotics, Inc. Completes Delivery Under $2.8 Million Defense Contract in Asia-Pacific
stories.summary: XTEND AI Robotics' Asia-Pacific subsidiary, Performance Rotors Pte Ltd, completed delivery of 88 unmanned aerial systems and 84 ground control stations under a $2.8 million defense contract in September 2026. The order, which included integrated logistics support, falls within the company's preliminary revenue range of $24.5 to $26.5 million through September 30, 2026.

also.title: XTEND AI Robotics (XTND) Stock: Expands Defense Footprint With 88 Drone Deliveries

stories.title: Ohio State installs police assistance drones on three campus buildings
stories.summary: Ohio State University installed Skydio drone docking stations on the Journalism Building, Blankenship Hall, and the WOSU Public Media building in March. The $1.16 million, five-year contract with Axon includes equipment, training, and software to link police command centers with campus cameras. Non-sworn staff pilot the drones, which deploy in under 40 seconds to assist with priority calls.

stories.title: China's Baidu launches AI model simulating road environment for robotaxis
stories.summary: Baidu launched Apollo World on Tuesday, an AI system that generates up to 100,000 km of simulated driving daily to train its Apollo Go robotaxi fleet. The system produces real-time camera and lidar data streams, enabling autonomous vehicles to sense and navigate simulated environments.

also.title: Baidu launches AI system to train robotaxis for global expansion
China's Baidu Builds Virtual Roads to Accelerate Robotaxi Development
Baidu launches Apollo World to train robotaxis in simulation

stories.title: Mach brings autonomous vegetation control to U.S. solar farms
stories.summary: Mach announced a commercial solar mowing solution for independent power producers operating utility-scale solar assets. The company will showcase the autonomous platform at RE+ 26, November 16-19, 2026, at the Las Vegas Convention Center, West Hall.

stories.title: Two Australians killed in Spain’s second high-speed rail crash this year
stories.summary: Two Australians were among the 69 people killed when a passenger train slammed into a stationary train in the province of Toledo, near Madrid. Spain’s government declared three days of mourning after the crash, which occurred on the same rail line as a January disaster that killed 46 people.

also.title: International Victims Identified as Death Toll Reaches 69 in Spanish Train Collision
Spain says to work 'tirelessly' to restore trust in trains after disasters
Europe Today: Second high-speed rail disaster in nine months leaves Spain in grief
Spanish transport minister offers resignation after deadly train crash
Spain's transport minister steps down 6 days after fatal high-speed rail crash
Spanish transport minister resigns after two deadly high-speed rail accidents this year
Spain Train Crash Kills 69, Including Four Americans
Two Australians confirmed dead in Spain’s high-speed train crash

stories.title: Kalashnikov “demonstrates multi-layered C-UAS”
stories.summary: Kalashnikov demonstrated a layered counter-unmanned aerial system on 2 November that combines radar, the Krona anti-aircraft missile system, and the Kalitka-KA automated turret. The company claims Kalitka-KA systems destroyed more than 200 drones over three months in one operational sector.

stories.title: So What’s Going On With the Cybercab?
stories.summary: Tesla began offering Cybercab rides in Austin on 4 September 2026, charging a median $3.33 USD per mile. The vehicle includes a NACS port and wireless charging receiver, but lacks an onboard charger to accept AC power from a home supply.

stories.title: Why America Is Buying More ISR Drones
stories.summary: The US government ordered a new tranche of unmanned aerial systems from AIRO Group Holdings, marking the McLean, Virginia-based company's entry into the US market after years of European sales. AIRO announced the sale on Monday but did not disclose the specific agency, financial value, or number of aircraft involved.

stories.title: Drone U Brings Professional Engineering Continuing Education to Flight Training
stories.summary: Drone U, a Colorado-based flight school, offers licensed professional engineers 24 professional development hours through FAA Part 107 training. The program is subject to acceptance by state licensing boards and includes instruction in aviation regulations, airspace, and flight safety.

stories.title: $22 million railroad grant supports grain movement in Minnesota
stories.summary: Twin Cities & Western Railroad Company was awarded $22 million in federal funding in October through the Consolidated Rail Infrastructure and Safety Improvements Program for a major rail infrastructure and grain transportation project. The CRISI grant will fund 200 new covered hopper rail cars and rail infrastructure improvements.

stories.title: Celebrate the best of UK rail at the 2027 Rail Business Awards
stories.summary: Virgin Group reached a binding agreement with Alstom on October 9 for 12 Avelia Stream high-speed trains, including 30 years of maintenance. The company also announced Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse-inspired social spaces at stations and integration of flight bookings into its rail offering.

stories.title: From Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes: India’s Bullet Train vision gets a major push, with Make in India at its core
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi approved the Northern Corridor of the bullet train network, connecting Delhi, Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Patna and Siliguri, with an extension to Guwahati. Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the project would be built under the Make in India vision, with construction components manufactured domestically.

stories.title: Saab's new unmanned boat packs powerful air defense system
stories.summary: Saab unveiled the Combat Boat 90 Capability X in three variants, including an SHORAD configuration equipped with an automatic anti-aircraft gun. Production is currently underway for Sweden, the first customer to adopt this class of vessels.

also.title: Fast autonomous combat boat packs missile-firing power at speeds over 45 mph

stories.title: Archer and ITA Airways Join Forces to Develop Electric Air Taxi Services in Italy
stories.summary: Archer Aviation Inc. and ITA Airways signed an agreement to partner on an all-electric air taxi network in Italy using Archer’s Midnight aircraft. ITA Airways becomes the first European carrier to join Archer’s global network of airline partners, extending its commercialization strategy already underway in the U.S., UAE, and beyond.

stories.title: The only U.S. pure-play humanoid robotics stock begins trading this week
stories.summary: Shareholders of Churchill Capital Corp XI approved a business combination with Agility Robotics, raising approximately $465 million in gross capital. Trading is expected to start on November 5, making Agility the only U.S. publicly listed pure-play humanoid robotics company with active commercial deployments.

also.title: Agility Robotics clears shareholder vote, expected to go public this week
Agility Robotics Begins Trading On Nasdaq As AGLT After SPAC Vote

stories.title: SPARC AI Expands UAV Technology Reach with European Integration Agreement and Middle East Strategy
stories.summary: SPARC AI Inc. signed a Memorandum of Understanding with an unnamed European drone manufacturer to integrate its Overwatch GPS-independent positioning technology on two new fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. The company also agreed with a regional advisory firm to support defense and commercial opportunities in the Middle East following operational validation of Overwatch under GPS spoofing conditions.

stories.title: No diesel, no overhead wires–How India’s hydrogen train actually works
stories.summary: Indian Railways flagged off its first hydrogen-powered passenger train, “Namo Green Rail,” on 17 July 2026, on the Jind-Sonipat section in Haryana. The 10-coach train features two hydrogen-powered driving units with a combined power output of 2,400 kilowatts and is approved to operate at up to 75 kmph.

also.title: Explained:India’s First Hydrogen - Powered Train Advances Green Rail Mobility

stories.title: Republic of Korea establishes new UAS and C-UAS military unit
stories.summary: The Republic of Korea’s Ministry of Defence launched the National Defence Drone Headquarters to replace its Drone Operations Command. The new unit aims to speed up system acquisition through a fast-track certification system, with service branches handling specific drone and counter-drone roles while the Joint Chiefs of Staff coordinate operations.

stories.title: A 4,800-pound drone boat that blew a hole in a retired warship off Hawaii won't be bought again after
stories.summary: AEVEX stated that the Navy has not halted orders for the Global Autonomous Reconnaissance Craft, asserting that BlackSea Technologies delivered all 325 boats last year. The company said the Navy is modifying the existing contract to about $350 million through June 2027 to fund upgrades and new mission gear for the current fleet.

stories.title: Railway Interiors Market to Reach US$ 30.3 Billion by 2033 Driven by Fleet Expansion
stories.summary: Persistence Market Research expects the global railway interiors market to reach US$ 30.3 Billion by 2033, growing from US$ 17.9 Billion in 2026 at a 7.8% CAGR. Asia Pacific leads with 42% of global revenue in 2026, while Passenger Seating Systems hold a 26% share of interior components.

stories.title: Views of Ashish Bansal: NFR’s vision for transformative rail connectivity
stories.summary: Ashish Bansal, General Manager, North Frontier Railway (Construction), stated that the current project portfolio spans 1,827 km of new line and doubling projects with an overall project cost of about Rs 961.41 billion. The five-year commissioning plan further envisages around 3,997 km new lines and doubling, and third and fourth line works planned across NFR (Construction) up to 2030-31.

stories.title: Rheinmetall and Silvus Technologies Partner to Advance Airspace Security and Counter-UAS Capabilities
stories.summary: Rheinmetall Air Defence AG agreed with Silvus Technologies to integrate passive radio-frequency (RF) sensing technology into its Skynex Air Defence System and Skymaster command-and-control platform. The collaboration adds RFeye sensors to detect unmanned aircraft and other aerial threats without transmitting signals, complementing existing radar systems to improve situational awareness.

HII Moves First ROMULUS Drone Ship Closer to Completion
stories.summary: Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII) installed a commemorative hull plaque on the first ROMULUS 151 autonomous surface vessel in Louisiana on October 27, 2026. The company completed the structural build of the vessel in September, clearing the way for deck and pilothouse installation.

stories.title: Renfe updates safety protocol as investigators analyse Urda collision
stories.summary: Renfe introduced a new safety directive requiring high-speed trains to halt and proceed at a maximum speed of 40 km/h under visual supervision after cab signalling failures. The decision follows the fatal Urda collision that killed at least 69 people.

stories.title: Early Uber Investor: Tesla and Uber Will “Split 80%” of the Robotaxi Market
stories.summary: Angel investor Jason Calacanis bought 15,000 Uber shares at $65 and 3,000 Tesla shares at $357, predicting Tesla and Uber will split 80% of the autonomous vehicle market. He forecasts Tesla will hold 40% and Uber 35% of the market, while Waymo will capture 15%.

stories.title: A3 Robot Safety Conference Opens Monday: North American Cobot Orders Surge 56%
stories.summary: North American manufacturers ordered 10,989 industrial robots worth $723.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, a 24.8% increase in units over the same period last year, according to the Association for Advancing Automation. Collaborative robot orders grew 56% year-over-year, driven by semiconductor and life sciences facilities that require cage-free automation to meet strict contamination standards.

stories.title: IDF begins installing anti-drone nets to protect border positions from explosive UAVs
stories.summary: The IDF launched a pilot to install physical mesh nets at three border installations along the Gaza Strip to intercept or prematurely detonate oncoming unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The nets are designed to counter fiber-optic drones, which are completely immune to conventional electronic warfare, with plans to cover remaining outposts within months.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Reports Fresh Drone Interception As US Strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's military coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone over the Makkah region on Tuesday, hours after the United States carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island. Coalition spokesperson Major General Turki Al-Maliki announced the interception but did not disclose the drone's origin, intended target, or whether it caused damage or casualties.

stories.title: Perseus Defense tests cheap missile against drone
stories.summary: Perseus Defense released video of its low-cost interceptor hitting a hovering drone, a shot the company’s chief executive described as the first time an “attritable” missile has shot down a drone. The Texas-based firm aims for a price below $10,000 per shot for its Harpe missile, which is about 61 cm (24 inches) long with a stated range of 2 km (1.2 miles).

stories.title: Chess Dynamics introduces equipment support framework
stories.summary: Chess Dynamics launched ChessPlus, a support framework for its counter-uncrewed aerial systems equipment that helps customers plan for spares, repairs, and obsolescence before they impact system availability. The modular framework supports both new and existing systems, shifting emphasis from traditional after-sales support to continuing support throughout the system lifecycle.

stories.title: EURONAVAL 2026: KNDS AND SEAOWL PARTNER TO DEVELOP A SURFACE DRONE EQUIPPED WITH A NEXT-GENERATION NAVAL LOITERING MUNITION
stories.summary: KNDS and SeaOwl Technology Solutions signed a strategic cooperation agreement at Euronaval 2026 to develop an unmanned surface vehicle carrying a KNDS warhead. The vehicle reaches 35 knots, carries a 30 kg payload, and has a 200 km combat range.

stories.title: 80 kmph, 557 passengers! India's homegrown bullet train has some big surprises inside
stories.summary: BEML is building India's first indigenously designed bullet train at its Bengaluru facility for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor. The 202-metre-long, eight-coach train accommodates 557 passengers and is designed to reach a maximum testing speed of 280 kmph.

stories.title: NATO Tests 5G Networks and AI for Drone Detection in Baltic Exercise
stories.summary: NATO connected a Maven targeting system to a national military system using agentic artificial intelligence and conducted a cross-border drone interception during the DiBaX 2026 exercise in Latvia from October 19 to October 30. The alliance also tested commercial 5G networks for communications continuity and drone detection, with European Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis announcing two drone technology innovation centers in Latvia and the Netherlands for 2027.

stories.title: XTI Aerospace Announces Drone Detection Partnership With AirSight
stories.summary: XTI Aerospace announced a partnership with AirSight on November 2, 2026, to expand the drone detection offerings of its subsidiary Drone Nerds. The collaboration integrates AirSight's AirGuard software with compatible detection systems to provide real-time alerts for law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and other enterprise customers.

stories.title: Inside an Amazon warehouse where people and robots work side by side
stories.summary: Business Insider toured Amazon's fulfillment center in Tracy, California, where robots carry shelves and sort packages while thousands of people pick orders and clear jams. The facility is not fully automated, as workers step in when the automated system hits a problem it cannot solve.

stories.title: Laser weapons add another layer of security at Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate amid rising drone threats
stories.summary: NORAD and US northern command confirmed that the US Secret Service requested the deployment of an AeroVironment LOCUST laser system at President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida. Photographs taken on October 31 show the weapon mounted on a 4x4 Joint Light Tactical Vehicle, adding a layer to existing air-defence networks including Avenger systems and radar.

stories.title: HD Hyundai Robotics Cuts Troubleshooting to 8 Days With Palantir
stories.summary: HD Hyundai Robotics reduced average robot troubleshooting time from 21.5 days to 7.9 days after introducing AI agents developed with Palantir in August. The company expects programming costs to fall by more than 50% and plans to train field engineers to implement these AI-based solutions.
